text: 证监会副主席李超10日下午在国新办新闻发布会上表示，进一步加强监管和投资者保护。坚守金融工作的人民性，持续强化“五大监管”，聚焦欺诈发行、财务造假、操纵市场、内幕交易等重大违法行为，着力在“打准、打疼”上下功夫，提高监管执法威慑力。加快推动健全资本市场法律制度体系，完善投资者保护制度机制，让投资者切实感受到市场的公平正义。
text_en: CSRC Vice Chairman Li Chao said at a press conference held by the State Council Information Office on the afternoon of the 10th that supervision and investor protection will be further strengthened. Adhering to the people-centered nature of financial work, continuously strengthening the "five major areas of supervision," focusing on major illegal acts such as fraudulent issuance, financial fraud, market manipulation and insider trading, and concentrating efforts on "hitting accurately and hitting hard" to increase the deterrent power of regulatory enforcement. Accelerate the improvement of the legal and institutional system of the capital market and refine institutional mechanisms for investor protection, so that investors can truly feel the fairness and justice of the market.
